newsitem.title: CHINA: China military to use new generation of weapons.
newsitem.headline: China military to use new generation of weapons.

text.p: The Chinese People's Liberation Army (PLA) will gradually adopt a new generation of light armaments already carried by its crack Hong Kong Garrison, the People's Daily said on Tuesday.

Made domestically with advanced materials and manufacturing techniques, these small-bore, automatic rifles and machineguns are smaller, lighter, more powerful and have a longer range than comparable foreign weapons, the newspaper said.
The automatic rifles and machine guns are already used by PLA troops in Hong Kong, which reverted to Chinese sovereignty on July 1 after 156 years of British colonial rule.
The same technology used to manufacture the light weapons were currently being used to produce heavy machineguns, sniper rifles, and grenade launchers, it said.
Shocked by the high-tech warfare of the Gulf War, China has been trying to modernise its backward armed forces, which still uses Soviet designs 30 or 40 years out of date.

While China plans to trim its three-million-strong force by 500,000 troops, its published defence budget would rise 14.7 percent to $9.7 billion in 1997, although that figure was widely believed to be only a portion of actual defence spending.
